76	points/rank block in the profile panel with reduced text on mobile. The card's Difficulty
77	override is `trivial` (it wins). The change lives in one CSS block (`.profile-stats*` in
78	`src/styles/LandPage.css`) plus at most the matching markup in `src/components/UserProfile.tsx`,
79	no logic — so haiku was defensible under the "trivial → haiku" row.
80	Decision: keep `trivial` (override) but set `engineModel: sonnet`. The haiku row is for
81	content/copy/config edits with zero judgment; "find a better way that takes less space" is a
82	small layout design call with a responsive breakpoint and a real-browser check, which is the
83	sonnet default. No design round (single area, thin spec) → `planModel: fable` is nominal.

89	Context: card 3dc2cfb1-c595-8068-ac4c-cee34b4124e6 (Difficulty override `trivial`, frontend

92	`type="back"` pages the fixed `setTimeout(..., 350)` races the exit fade + Next route push, so
93	the element is often absent when the scroll fires. Fable was defensible because the fix is
94	small and involves a real timing subtlety (Next App Router push + sticky header + hash scroll).
95	Decision: `engineModel: sonnet`. The work reduces to explicit steps with done-checks (retarget
96	to `games-grid`; replace the fixed delay with a scroll-after-arrival mechanism such as a hash or
97	a `Landpage` mount effect; update Rule UI-3 in `UI_SHELL_CONSTRAINTS.md`; browser pass from
98	`/admin` and a game page on a phone viewport). Difficulty stays `trivial` per the override.
99	Consequences: small nav/scroll timing fixes stay on sonnet as long as the target and the
100	arrival mechanism can be named up front; fable is reserved for cases where the mechanism itself
